products.name: EX Dragon Frontiers Booster Box
products.note: 36 packs of 9 cards, no code card (Potomac Distribution box page and TCGplayer's pack text). TCGplayer lists the box without a market price, so it is priced at 36 packs.

products.name: EX Dragon Frontiers Single Blister Pack
products.note: One Dragon Frontiers booster pack in a blister (TCGplayer product 616216; the research found no promo for it). TCGplayer lists it without a market price, so it is priced at one pack.
